As a user of Automation Exercise
  I want to manage items in my cart

steps.name: Given user is on the home page
Verify home page is visible
When user adds product 1 to cart from home page
Add product to cart from home page at index 1
Click on element
And user clicks Continue Shopping
Click Continue Shopping in modal
Click on element located by: By.xpath: //button[contains(text(),'Continue Shopping')]
And user adds product 2 to cart from home page
Add product to cart from home page at index 2
Click on element
And user clicks View Cart in modal
Click View Cart in modal
Click on element located by: By.xpath: //u[contains(text(),'View Cart')]
Then cart page should be displayed
Verify cart page is displayed
And cart should contain 2 products
When user removes product at row 1
